demo.pageDescription: Create, attach, exchange and measure your own saved samples. Conversation sends only what you explicitly enter.
demo.sessionJobsHint: Only job IDs returned by submissions in this app session are retained here. After restarting, use a known detail link to view your own job.
demo.noteHint: Up to 4096 Unicode scalars. Measurement counts the scalars in the note; changing the note requires measuring again.
demo.formHint: Codes cannot change after creation. The server validates saves. On a version conflict, your input stays; close the form and refresh the detail before reviewing.
demo.attachmentRules: One txt, md, png or PDF per sample. Only txt, md and png support preview; PDF can only be saved as a copy.
demo.attachmentMissing: The attachment is registered but its local file is missing.
demo.attachmentRemoved: The association and registration were removed. The kernel reclaims disk content, retrying later if cleanup fails.
demo.listHint: Filters and pagination read real data. Use the master/detail view on wide screens; narrow screens open the existing detail route.
demo.selectSample: Select a sample to view its details
demo.importRules: Files contain code, title, note and stage columns. Code and title are required; note is optional. Stage is ignored on import and new records are drafts. Existing codes cause errors or are skipped according to the selected mode; duplicate codes within the file and invalid data still fail. Validated data is written in one transaction. Export includes all matching records; exporting an empty result produces headers.
demo.measureHint: Select 1–1000 of your samples and review before submitting one job. Each batch commits real results; cancellation takes effect between batches and committed results remain.
demo.reviewHint: These are the versions captured when selected. Changes, deletion or revoked permissions cause an explicit failure, with no automatic rerun.
demo.jobHint: Accepting cancellation does not mean the job has ended; committed batches remain. Verify an unknown result before resubmitting; no automatic retry.
demo.conversationHint: Only explicitly submitted input is sent. Samples and attachments are never read or sent. Messages stay in this page's session memory and clear when leaving. Configure the service in AI settings first. Stop only ends local reception and cannot promise to reverse remote charges.
demo.title: Sample library
demo.description: View your practice cards. The list and counts reflect saved data.
demo.settingsHint: Batch size is read when the next measurement job starts. Running jobs keep their batch size.
demo.attachmentCleanup: Removing an attachment clears its association and registration. The storage system cleans up its content; failed cleanup is left for later reclamation.
demo.notificationDisabled: Notifications are disabled. Job results remain available in your job progress.

showcase.menus.catalog.command.title: Searchable command list

showcase.common.rules.SC-R01: Action semantics and public imports: use @/kit, give icon actions readable names, and prevent duplicate submissions while loading.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R02: Overlay semantics: name overlays, constrain and return focus, focus cancel first for destructive actions, and preserve input on failure.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R03: Input contract: associate labels, specify values and boundaries, make errors readable, and do not silently add units or precision.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R04: Menu semantics: separate navigation from actions, follow context, and provide visible keyboard and touch entry points.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R05: Template boundaries: the shell owns the viewport, templates compose kit components, and DataTable column references stay stable.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R06: Appearance preview: one bridge and one lease, memory only; leaving restores the latest saved facts.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R07: Navigation tree: at most two levels; filter leaves before removing empty parents; only leaves produce navigation commands.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R08: Removal and consistency: pages, catalog entries and examples share their sources; test disabling and physical removal separately.

showcase.appearance.tokenRules: Use semantic classes such as bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border and rounded-lg. Never hard-code colors, corner radii or shadows. Describe state with text too.
showcase.appearance.contrastHint: Values come from computed styles; transparent colors are composited onto the background. See the state matrix below for all contrast results.
showcase.appearance.contrastContract: The theme system owns the contrast contract; this page only reads its results. Normal text requires 4.5:1 and control boundaries and focus require 3:1. High text contrast raises designated text pairs to 7:1. Failures remain visible.
showcase.appearance.example.title: Sample card · Observatory
showcase.appearance.example.description: This fictional card uses semantic tokens only. Its colors and shape update when the theme changes.
Choose semantic classes for content, borders, secondary text and shape so light/dark mode, all seven themes and accents apply automatically.
Do not copy a theme’s hex colors, fixed radii or shadows into business components. Use DataTable for tabular data.
showcase.appearance-behavior.title: Geometry, motion & windows
showcase.appearance-behavior.scene: Inspect effective geometry and motion, practice disclosure interactions, and check window controls and long-content boundaries.
showcase.appearance-behavior.geometryHin: Radii, control height, row height and page padding come directly from computed styles; density comes from the effective appearance. Samples share their implementation with the style guide.
showcase.appearance-behavior.motionHint: The motion switch above enables the full theme effects or turns animation off. Reduced motion applies only when “Follow system animation setting” is on. The matrix retains internal engine levels and CSS readings for development, not as user choices. Durations include theme rhythm scaling; the sample enters with kit-enter and exits by immediate removal.
showcase.appearance-behavior.disclosureH: New kit components. Use Collapsible for one region and Accordion for multiple sections, with explicit single/multiple mode and heading levels. Height animation follows the motion level; off or an active system reduced-motion preference makes changes immediate.
showcase.appearance-behavior.windowContr: When the system title bar is hidden, window controls replace it: square, flush to the edge and neutral in every visual theme. These local samples do not operate native windows; the close prompt is an in-memory demonstration.
showcase.appearance-behavior.collapsible: Supporting content stays associated with its trigger. Focus remains on the button after opening; use Tab to continue through the content.
showcase.appearance-behavior.accordion.t: The same component follows the current theme without a second set of colors or radii.
showcase.appearance-behavior.accordion.m: With motion off or an active system reduced-motion preference, content remains readable and disclosure does not depend on animation completion.
showcase.appearance-behavior.accordion.k: Up/Down moves between headings, Home/End goes to the first/last, and Enter/Space expands or collapses.
showcase.appearance-behavior.accordion.l: A long section title to check wrapping, focus boundaries and the expand icon in a narrow window
Long content wraps naturally. Multiple mode lets this section and keyboard guidance remain open together.
showcase.appearance-behavior.motion.cont: The sample has entered; the current theme and motion contract control its animation.
showcase.appearance-behavior.motion.hidd: The sample has exited and can enter again.
showcase.appearance-behavior.catalog.col: Hide nonessential supporting content behind a named keyboard-accessible trigger, controlled by open.
Use Accordion for several related titled sections. Do not hide the only error message or an essential action.
showcase.appearance-behavior.catalog.acc: Use when sections need keyboard navigation and explicit single/multiple expansion. Match headingLevel to the page’s heading hierarchy.
Use Tabs for mutually exclusive views and Collapsible for one region. Do not use accordions as main navigation.
showcase.appearance-behavior.catalog.mot: Add kit-enter and data-motion-item to new content so the theme, motion level and system reduced-motion preference, followed by default, control its entrance together.
Never hard-code duration, displacement or scale, or treat animation completion as business completion. Leave overlay transitions to kit components.

showcase.measure.guide: Follow the real measurement workflow through jobs, progress, completion notifications and declarative settings. This guide explains the flow; it does not report a running job. Starting a measurement submits a real job.
showcase.measure.select: Select practice cards: retain the selected records and their versions.

showcase.measure.watch: Watch progress: job details show actual progress and results.

showcase.measure.configure: Declarative settings: inspect the measurement batch size in demo settings.
showcase.conversation.guide: T8 ConversationPage provides message display and controlled input only. This page connects a real stream through the AI module’s public useAiChat interface, managing context, send, stop and draft retention after failure. Only sending initiates an AI service request.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R09: In-page navigation and sections: use tabs, pagination, steppers, breadcrumbs, collapsible regions and accordions to express position, sections and progress within a page. Indicate the current item without relying on color (using `aria-current` or expanded state), make it keyboard accessible, and adapt to narrow windows with scrolling or collapsing. Do not introduce a third level of main navigation.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R10: Feedback and status: explain in-progress, completed, empty and failed states with readable text. Errors and empty states must explain the actual cause and the next step. Do not invent percentages when progress is unknown. Color must not be the only signal, and automatically dismissed notifications must not be the only source of information.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R11: Data display: keep table and list column definition references stable. Place row actions in the context of the record and retain a visible entry point; right-click is only a supplement. Provide empty, loading and error states. Wrap or truncate long text while retaining a way to view the full content.
showcase.common.rules.SC-R12: Theme compatibility: use only semantic tokens and kit components. Do not hard-code colors, corner radii, shadows or animation durations. Color must not be the only signal. Respect the selected motion level and follow system reduced motion by default; turning off “Follow system animation setting” ignores the system preference. Contrast must meet or exceed the theme contract.

styleguide.controls.title: All implemented appearance axes
styleguide.controls.contract: Labels, options and defaults come from the generated contract. This DEV-only preview may inspect product-locked axes. Source and lock readings describe saved host settings, not saved preview changes.
styleguide.controls.constraints: Effective dark: {{dark}}; reduced motion active: {{reducedMotion}}; host media: {{background}}. High-contrast themes use high contrast, inherited axes use the shell values. Off disables motion; system motion is ignored by default. Effect intensity is selected manually: low, medium or high. Subtle motion does not scale elements.
styleguide.coverage.title: Overall scenarios and coverage gaps
styleguide.coverage.summary: {{scenes}} deterministic scenarios, {{axes}} axes and {{pairs}} axis pairs: {{covered}} sampled and {{uncovered}} unsampled value pairs. Enumeration is not execution or visual acceptance, and does not claim full pairwise coverage.
styleguide.coverage.local: Independent local matrices: colors {{colors}}; four geometry groups {{geometry}}; motion {{motion}}; background mode/reduced transparency {{backgrounds}}. They are not multiplied together or credited to overall scenario coverage.
styleguide.coverage.limitations: Uploaded image IDs are unbounded; pairs count none and the builtin catalog. Black/white/checker PNG scenarios need host-sanitized resources from the maintainer. DPI, forced colors, viewport, permissions, sources and preview races are directed checks. pref-acceptance exports every axis pair and gap.
